title: Swarm V2.2 completion-throughput upgrade
objective: Make the control plane react to live PR work-in-flight instead of only lane states, apply adaptive review depth, prioritize completion/integration under backlog pressure, and keep new Go workers advancing retained value without branch/PR explosion.

slots.role: Implement and prove Swarm V2.2 throughput policy
Adversarial review of V2.2 scheduler and review policy

acceptance: scheduler counts live PR-bearing claims as completion backlog
soft backlog pressure boosts review/integration roles
hard backlog pressure suppresses normal new primaries, audits, adversarial tests, and capacity mining while preserving red-main/control repair
every new controlled PR self-reviews its exact head before acceptance
low-risk work can integrate after self-review plus CI/ownership
standard work requires an independent exact-head spot check
critical authority/reality/control work requires an independent exact-head full review
existing pre-V2.2 PRs are grandfathered and do not fail merely for missing new metadata
completion queues disappear when actual product backlog drains so they cannot self-deadlock creation
30-worker simulation and deterministic/adversarial control tests pass in canonical CI and Swarm Control Plane CI
real live board exposes completion pressure and useful completion slots
